rows.grounds: locative plural of a compound referent

items.question: Under what condition are beings tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: A count of eighty-four thousand is specified.
The location is given as womb-diagrams.
The state attributed to beings is one of torment.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in the specified set of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The agent or cause of torment is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
